
;ci'oi:COI2 [[Phenomimes and psychomimes|Phenomimes and psychomimes]] ([[Experimental cmavo|Experimental cmavo]] proposed by [[tijlan|tijlan]].) 

Converts following cmevla or zoi-quote into psychomime. Narrower term than [[tai'i|tai'i]]. See also [[BPFK Section: Case sumtcita i'o]], [[sa'ei|sa'ei]], [[ki'ai|ki'ai]].

* Examples in some languages. 
** jpn: そわそわ (sowasowa): restlessly.

** nep: सुखदुख (sukhadukha): lit. happiness-sorrow; the human condition.
** eng: zing
